name: pain-dream-fix
purpose: Per-paragraph check of an e-bomb, sales page or email against Pain-Dream-Fix (Amy Hoy, 30x500). Laya tags each paragraph; founder_audit/pain_dream_fix.py works out the order and flags premature pitching; Claude writes the feedback.
notes: section is a three-way choice. pitches_product is a separate question because a paragraph can describe the reader's pain and still slip in the product.
No accuracy has been measured on this set yet.

section.instructions: What is this paragraph mainly doing for the reader?

criteria.pain: describes a problem, frustration or cost the reader has today, in their own terms
criteria.dream: describes what the reader's work or life looks like once the problem is gone, without naming a product
criteria.fix: presents a solution, product, feature, offer, price or call to action

pitches_product.instructions: Does this paragraph mention or promote the writer's own product, service, feature or offer?
